summary: Race fails round 1 on gameplay: 6/10, with four major issues. The engineering holds up. race-scenarios passes 15/15. race-soak passes for seeds 1-3 (races end at 165-181 s, nobody stuck more than 1 s, 0 console errors). tsc is clean, and about 15 of my own browser runs logged 0 errors. Every lifecycle event fires exactly once: race:intro, countdown 3-2-1-0, start, finalStretch and end. Results, coins and saved stats are correct. A KO cinematic running when the player finishes restores the clock and camera cleanly. Bell/angry hunting works. The intro flyover with name cards, the traffic (fish truck, honks, hazard lights) and the corgi are charming. As a game, though, level 1 is neither fair nor tense. (1) The goose is gridded next to the player and opens with heavy hits at GO. The player drops from 108 to 39 HP by 2.8 s and is KO'd within 10.5-24.3 s in 5 of 7 level-1 runs, whether passive or fighting back. In one race the goose made 26 of the 52 swings and scored all 3 KOs on a passive player. (2) The police corgi cannot be outrun. It rode alongside for 52-55 of 70 s for both a full-throttle player and the boosting autopilot, whistle-slowed every 6.0 s and never gave up. Being crashed next to it is an automatic BUSTED 2.0 s later. A player who fights has the corgi on them from about 35-42 s until the finish. (3) Races are not close. Winners finish 21-28 s ahead of a non-boosting player (median leader gap 217-271 m). Cat or sloth won 6 of 7 completed races, and the capybara was last in all 12 standings I checked. (4) race:finishLine announces crossing order, but BUSTED penalties and same-substep ties reorder the final standings: a busted player who crosses first is told FINISH 1ST and then shown 2nd. Minor issues: the launch boost is labelled 'BOOST! 加速带', every rival casts its skill in the first 5 s, places flicker and the HUD shows 6TH at GO, rubber-band boosts are visible, optional event fields are never sent, traffic pops in at 336-405 m, and the corgi talks through generic toasts. Evidence and scripts: shots/review/race/r1-gameplay/ (human.mjs, probe.mjs, police.mjs, edge.mjs, popin.mjs, analyze.mjs plus *.txt/*.json logs and screenshots).

issues.title: Level 1 AI mugs the player from GO: KO'd within 10-25 s in 5 of 7 runs
issues.detail: Several rules stack up. grid.ts places the 5th-strongest rival (almost always the goose, aggression 0.95) in slot 5, beside the player. fight.ts:53 weights the player 3x as a hunt target, and fight.ts:75 multiplies attack chance by 1.4 when hunted, so the goose attacks on every ~0.7 s reaction tick and 73% of those attacks are heavy. ai/index.ts:52 adds a +7% hunt sprint, so a goose on an erba (19 m/s) keeps pace with the player's 20 m/s roadbike. personality.ts:46 adds 0.05 per level above 1, so there is no easing at level 1. Measured with a human-like controller (human.mjs, passive-starts.txt): seed 3 passive took heavy hits of 23/23/23 at 0.9/1.7/2.3 s and a 36 crit at 8.3 s, with HP 108→39 at 2.8 s, 3 at 8.7 s and a KO at 14.8 s (band-3-1.png shows 3/108 HP at 0:10). The goose made 26 of the race's 52 swings and landed all 20 hits and 3 KOs on the player. Seeds 1/2/4 passive: the goose landed 8/6/7 hits in the first 20 s, KO at 23.4/15.5/24.3 s. Seed 3 brawler (fights back): 59 dmg in 1.6 s, KO at 10.5 s. Overall the AI aims 24-40% of all its hits at the player, who is 1 of 8 riders. The first impression of the first race is WRECKED before the first corner.
issues.fix: In fight.ts chooseTarget/melee, do not hunt or attack the player before race time 6 s. Scale aggression by level (e.g. t.aggression * (0.6 + 0.1*lv)). Reduce the player weight to about 1.5 at levels 1-2. Add a hunt budget: after landing 2 hits on the player within 4 s, the hunter drops the hunt and cools down 3-5 s. Do not start a hunt on a player below 30% HP unless angry. Allow at most one hunter on the player at a time (a token in ai/index.ts). At level 1, grid.ts should keep the most aggressive rival off slots 3/5. Add a race-scenarios regression: passive player, seeds 1-6, level 1 → at most 2 hits in the first 6 s and no KO in the first 30 s.

issues.title: Police corgi cannot be outrun or shaken, so it escorts you to the finish
issues.detail: police.ts:16 gives the corgi a cruise speed of 22 m/s after an 8 s sprint at 25.5, above the roadbike's 20 m/s. chase() sets its speed to player.speed + gap*0.7, so it always matches you. police.ts:157 only gives up when gap > 80 m with heat < 0.3, or gap > 150 m, which is unreachable while it rides at your speed. police.txt: a full-throttle human-like player was ridden alongside for 55.5 of 70 s, with 11 whistles at exactly 6.0 s intervals (each a 1 s -15% slow) and 9 corgi lines. Heat fell to 0.14 and the corgi stayed. The autopilot, with drift boosts and skills, was ridden alongside for 52 of 70 s and never escaped. Fighting rivals keeps heat at 0.85-1.0 (x1.6 while watched). In the brawler races the corgi arrived at 34/42 s and stayed until the finish (seed 1, 125 s) or until BUSTED (seed 3). Crash/KO next to it: rider:crash at 23.63 → police:busted at 25.63, while tumbling (police-crash-busted.png), so the KO victim also eats −100 coins and +4 s. SPEC §9 says 'Outrun it to lose heat', but there is no counterplay at all. The chase stops being funny once it never ends (human-brawler-1-05/09.png: the same corgi alongside at 0:53 and 1:30).
issues.fix: After the sprint, cap the corgi at about 0.97x the player's base top speed. Give it stamina: after 15-20 s alongside without a bust it tires (-15% for 6 s, the 腿短 joke). Lose it at gap > 35-40 m held for 2 s. Cool heat 3x faster when the player commits no offence for 10 s. Let traffic block it: it should brake behind vehicles instead of steering through gaps via avoid(). Let player swings, torpedo or Wing Dash within reach knock it back for 3 s, done race-side by listening to combat:swing/projectile events and checking the corgi's s/x. Count 'crashed' toward BUSTED only for player-caused crashes (traffic/wall), not KOs by rivals. Add an 'outrun' scenario: a full-speed player with heat 0.95 and no further offences loses the corgi within 45 s.

issues.title: Races are not close: leaders run away and bike stats decide the result
issues.detail: Rival bikes span 16.5-22.5 m/s (±12%), but the band in ai/index.ts:49 is at most ±8%, and leaders only reach −8% at 200 m ahead (smoothstep 25→200). The fixie cat still runs at 20.7 m/s, faster than the player's 20. sloth.flash (skills.ts:31: +60% top for 3 s) fires whenever there is a 100 m straight with a rider ahead: 7-8 casts per race, about 24 s of +60%. Results: passive seed 3, the cat won by 21.5 s (median leader gap 271 m, max 433). Brawler seed 3, the sloth won by 28.1 s (median 217 m, max 482). Probe seed 1, the cat won by 22.8 s. Autopilot seed 2 at 95 s: sloth +183 m, capybara −219 m (aerial-2-70.png: the player riding alone). Soak spread at the end: 213-310 m. Cat or sloth won 6 of 7 completed races, and the capybara (shared bike) was 8th in all 12 standings checked. Only the hyper-aggressive scripted brawler (11 KOs) had a close race (seed 1: 0.2 s). The brief's bar, 'races are close and exciting', is not met for an average player.
issues.fix: Normalise AI pace to the player in ai/index.ts/brain.drive. While a rider is visible (−30…+60 m), cap its base top at playerTop * (1 + 0.02*(level-1) + small per-rider offset) so bike differences are compressed to about ±4% at level 1. Start easing leaders from about 40 m ahead and reach −8% by about 120 m. Allow up to +12% catch-up for riders more than 60 m behind, where it is unseen. Gate sloth.flash to race time > 8 s and to when the sloth is not leading. File a status request for level-appropriate rivalBikes (core buildConfig) so the capybara/penguin are not permanently last. Add a soak assertion: against a scripted throttle-only player, the median leader gap stays < 120 m and the last-placed character varies across seeds.

issues.title: race:finishLine place disagrees with the final standings (BUSTED penalty, same-substep ties)
issues.detail: standings.ts:36-40 sets finishTime = clock + penalty but emits place = crossing count. ahead() sorts finishers by the penalised time, so the final order can differ from the announced place. police.mjs 'order' (police.txt): a busted player crosses 0.6 s before rival 1. finishLine reports {player place 1, time 31.62} and {rival place 2, time 28.42}, but the final results put the rival 1st and the player 2nd. The HUD FINISH splash (cutins/layer.ts finish → e.place) and the audio announcer therefore call 1ST, then the results screen says 2nd. edge.mjs 'tie': two riders cross in one 1/120 s substep. finishLine gives the lower id place 1, while the standings keep the rider who was ahead in 1st. Both get the identical time 0.955, because there is no sub-step interpolation. This is likely in play: brawlers get busted (the police can't be escaped), and pack finishes happen (brawler seed 1: five riders within 2.2 s).
issues.fix: Serve the BUSTED penalty on the road: extend the ticket hold (police.ts HOLD 2.2 s) by the 4 s penalty instead of adding phantom time to finishTime, so crossing order equals final order. If phantom time is kept, emit finishLine only once the place is final (no unfinished rider can still beat the time) and have the HUD show 'provisional'. Interpolate the crossing time as t = clock − (s − length)/speed, and process riders that cross in the same substep in t order. Add 'penalty' and 'tie' race-scenarios asserting finishLine.place === final result place.

issues.title: Launch boost is emitted as a boost pad, so GO shows 'BOOST! 加速带'
issues.detail: flow.ts:51 emits rider:boost{kind:'pad'} for every launch. events-map has had kind 'launch' since this round, but it is not used. The HUD maps 'pad' to the boost-pad callout, so a held-throttle start and a perfect start both show 'BOOST! 加速带' (launch-go.png, perfect-start.png, HUD text in visual.mjs output). The PERFECT START reward is only a small generic top-right toast (flow.ts:52, perfect-start.png), with no P5 callout and no announcer.
issues.fix: Emit kind 'launch' (power 0.3 = perfect, 0.18 = normal). Ask ui-hud to show a 'LAUNCH!' or 'PERFECT START! 起步完美' callout with the drift-L3 colour for 'launch', and drop the toast.

issues.title: Every rival fires its signature skill in the first seconds, and the sloth gets a free super-launch
issues.detail: The 'useful' rules are trivially true in the grid crowd: capybara ≥2 riders within 10 m, cat a rider within 2.4 m, pigeon ≥2 within 5 m, shiba a threat. sloth.flash's `speed < 10` clause (skills.ts:31) is true at GO. Measured: passive seed 4 had 6 AI skills in 0.9-3.4 s. Brawler seed 3 had 5 in 0.4-2.4 s, including sloth.flash at 2.4 s; passive seeds 2/3 had sloth.flash at 4.0 s and 2 s. The start becomes a wall of cut-ins and auras (fight-1-1.png, pack-1-1-aerial.png), skills are spent before they can matter, and the sloth (speed stat 2) launches at +60% for 3 s.
issues.fix: In useSkill, do not cast AI skills before race time 5 s, then stagger first casts per rider (rng 5-15 s). Keep the `speed < 10` clause only after a respawn (r.modeTime < 2 after 'respawning'), not at the start.

issues.title: Places flicker at 0.35 m hysteresis, and the HUD shows 6TH at GO
issues.detail: PASS_MARGIN = 0.35 m (standings.ts:7) is less than a bike length. analyze.mjs found 5/104, 5/102 and 13/221 placeChange swap-backs within 1 s per race. For the player (brawler seed 1) that means ping-pong callouts: '5>4@98.6, 4>5@101.5, 5>4@101.8' and '3>4@42.8, 4>3@44.1'. Separately, grid.ts:35 assigns the player place 5 (slot 4), but the centre column is staggered 1.4 m back, so the first standings update at t=0 emits 5>6. The race opens with '6TH ▼ 被超了' for a pass that never happened (launch-go.png).
issues.fix: Add time hysteresis: a rider must hold the margin for about 0.4 s before places swap, or use a margin of about 1.0 m for player-involved swaps. In regrid, assign `place` from the post-stagger s order, or stagger so the slot order matches s.

issues.title: Rubber-band and hunt-sprint pulses show boost visuals on rivals near the player
issues.detail: ai/index.ts:53-56 sets boostTime 0.15 / boostPower 0.07-0.08 on hunters within 25 m and on riders more than 35 m behind. fx/react/emitters.ts streaks() and actors view (inp.boost) render these as boost streaks and the boost pose. probe.mjs: a rival within 12 m of the player was in a band micro-boost for 13% (seed 3) and 20% (seed 1) of race samples, e.g. the hunting goose 3-4 m ahead at 0:12-0:13 (band-1-1/3.png). SPEC §9 says 'never cheat visibly'. The status file already lists this as core request 5.
issues.fix: Until core adds a hidden speed factor, apply band pulses only to riders out of view (more than 35 m behind or more than 80 m ahead). Drop HUNT_SPRINT for hunters within 15 m ahead of the player, where they are on screen. Keep pushing core request 5 (RiderMods.rubber).

issues.title: Traffic pops into existence in plain view at 336-405 m
issues.detail: manage() spawns at p.s + 330…400 m (traffic/index.ts:76, spawner AHEAD 400), but coast fog only starts at 200 m and ends at 980 m (world/looks.ts:8), so vehicles at that range are only 17-26% fogged. popin.mjs projected every new vehicle into the chase camera during an autopilot race. All 25 spawns appeared inside the view frustum at 336-405 m, 3-7 px tall at 1080p (first: compact car at 337 m, t=8.7 s, popin-after-4.png). On the long coast straights that is visible pop-in; a commercial racer never shows it.
issues.fix: Spawn at or beyond about 0.75 × track.look.fog.far (about 730 m on the coast; city and mountain differ), and despawn same-direction vehicles further ahead to match. Alternatively, fade new vehicles in over 0.5 s (instance scale or alpha), or prefer spawn points out of the camera cone (behind curves or crests).

issues.title: Optional event fields are never sent, so audio's 'police.lost' cue can never play
issues.detail: events-map declares police:alert.reason?: 'spawn'|'lost'|'busted' (core request 4 was applied), but police.ts:56 never sets it. audio/events-race.ts:83 plays 'police.lost' only when reason === 'lost', so escaping the corgi is silent. The achievement tracker (ui/race-tracker.ts) also has to infer 腿短不是借口 from 'alerted && !busted'. race:intro also omits duration (logic.ts:41), although the HUD intro could pace its cards to INTRO_TIME = 3.6 s.
issues.fix: alert(level, reason): pass 'spawn' in spawn(), 'lost' in giveUp(true), and 'busted' in bust(). Emit race:intro { trackId, duration: INTRO_TIME }. Assert both in race-scenarios.

issues.title: Corgi dialogue uses generic top-right toasts instead of a bubble on the corgi
issues.detail: say() (police.ts:54) routes every corgi line, including the spawn taunt, the first whistle, chatter every 7-11 s while alongside and the fine, through app.ui.toast as a red 'warn' strip in the top-right corner. Rival taunts get world-anchored speech bubbles. police.txt counted 9 lines in 70 s. The jokes are good, but they are detached from the character on screen and compete with the KO/coin counters (police-busted-splash.png). The PERFECT START uses the same channel.
issues.fix: Ask ui-hud/core for a world-anchored line event for non-session actors, e.g. reuse 'taunt' with riderId 99 plus a pos, or add 'police:say' {text, pos}. Meanwhile, limit corgi toasts to spawn and the fine.

issues.title: cross-unit: combat's heavy-hit numbers turn the AI's opening aggression into near-instant KOs
issues.detail: Not race-owned, but it amplifies the first major issue. A level-1 goose (power 5) deals 23 per heavy with a baguette and 36 on a crit against the pelican's 108 HP, so three heavies take 64%. A goose that loses its weapon still lands 8/13 (crit) unarmed hits, 7 of them in 5.3 s (passive seed 3, 57.8-63.1 s). Combined with the AI's 0.7 s reaction and 73% heavy chance, a player gets no time to react.
issues.fix: Combat: consider level-scaled AI damage (e.g. ×0.7 at level 1) or a short post-hit grace for the player (0.4 s of no further heavy hits from the same attacker). Race: see the fix for the first major issue.
